Three-band ordering must hold strictly: median(high) > median(mid) > median(low)
High vs low separation: median(high) - median(low) >= 50 points (load-bearing precision claim)
High vs mid separation: median(high) - median(mid) >= 15 points (scorer must distinguish complete from naturally-thin)
Mid vs low separation: median(mid) - median(low) >= 15 points (scorer must distinguish naturally-thin from intentionally-bad)
Canary FP: 0 of 10 high-band specs scores below 60
Canary FN: 0 of 10 low-band specs scores above 60
loom spec-score SPEC-id --json exposes the full dict; exit code 0 even at low score (informational)
p50 latency budget: under 3000ms on Ollama, under 1000ms on Anthropic Haiku

description: A new `services.score_specification(spec_id, judge_model=None)` grades a Specification along four 0-25 dimensions: (1) acceptance_criteria — count of distinct testable criteria (0/none, 25 for >=3 measurable); (2) falsifiability — names a concrete observation/test that would refute the spec; (3) parent_alignment — elaborates parent_req without contradiction or pure repetition; (4) concreteness — avoidance of TBD/placeholder, presence of specific identifiers. Judge LLM dispatched via the M11.5 pattern (Anthropic Haiku if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set, else qwen3.5:latest temp=0; override via LOOM_SPEC_SCORE_MODEL). Returns {score:int 0-100, by_dim:{dim:int 0-25}, judge_model:str, latency_ms:int, reasoning:str}. CLI: `loom spec-score <SPEC-id> [--json]`. When LOOM_SPEC_SCORE_ON_CREATE=1, `loom spec` create scores in-band and warns when score < LOOM_SPEC_MIN_SCORE (default 60). Warning-only in v0. Implementation: src/loom/spec_scoring.py + src/loom/prompts/spec_score.txt. No store schema changes. THREE-BAND eval: high band = 10 hand-authored specs elaborating shipped features (M14/M15/M16/M20.1/M23/M24/M25) with full AC + falsifiers; mid band = the 21 existing M25-migration specs as-is (naturally-occurring concrete-but-thin); low band = 10 hand-authored TBD-stuffed/vague specs. Calibration fixtures locked at tests/data/spec_scoring_calibration.json before scorer is built — pre-registration.
